claims.text: TDV records specified Damascus elites submitting before Selim’s entry, followed by a later appointment and revolt. Cairo’s Hayir Bey operated a court with judges and subashi while retaining selected Mamluk aides. Military entry, appointment and working institutions have different dates and scopes; neither elite submission nor conquest establishes all residents’ consent or instant replacement of every office.
